Simply Wow! Must Try Pho in Hanoi
Jul 2026 • Friends
I ordered the special bowl with everything on it, including brisket, flank, and fillet beef, and it was absolutely delicious! The broth was so clean, rich, and flavorful. Every sip was just wow!

No wonder Pho 10 Ly Quoc Su has been recognized by the Michelin Guide from 2023 to 2026. It truly lives up to the reputation!

The location is easy to find in the Old Quarter. There was a bit of a queue when I arrived, which is understandable since it is one of the famous pho spots in Hanoi, but the wait was manageable and definitely worth it.

Great portion, amazing flavor, and such good value for money. I am staying in Hanoi for a couple of weeks, so I will definitely be back for lunch or an early dinner.

Highly recommended if you are in Hanoi and craving an authentic and satisfying bowl of pho!

Not my favorite overall.
Mar 2026 • Solo
Stood in line for about thirty minutes to get a spot for one. Despite the fame this place has gotten for its Michelin star, it seemed liked mostly locals—or at least Vietnamese—who were eating there. The service was abrupt—and maybe even borderline rude—but even that I wrote off as part of the experience. They’re so busy they don’t have to be nice because there are fifty other people waiting outside. If I had written this review immediately after eating the beef pho, five stars no doubt. But later that night I had the worst indigestion, worst feeling in my gut. I think it may have been that their broth is heavy on the onions. Either that or a chill sauce I added. It way it wrecked me for the rest of the day and I skipped dinner.

Average experience
Feb 2026 • Couples
As this restaurant was near our hotel and we hadn’t had a breakfast yet we thought that it could be nice to go to this Michelin restaurant to have a breakfast Pho.

One says that the first impression always matters. Well, that was half the case here. When queuing outside the shop, we smelled a stench that could foul the dirtiest quagmires. 

When our turn to be seated arrived, a quite stern woman placed us on a shared table where we could still appreciate the scent.

As for the food, we really found it pretty average. They have a list of pho and you can choose between different types of meat. I ordered a beef filet meat in my soup but I was skeptical on the piece I got.

All in all, the food here was average. The setting not helping whatsoever to lift the experience. I wouldn’t escpecially recommend. We ate an average pho with an horrible smell on a stern place.
